entries.t: <FACE:05>So they dig this place<NL>for Medabot material<WAIT><FACE:00>The path splits up<NL>ahead… don't get lost
<FACE:00>I think that's Raiun…<NL>Let's watch a bit
<FACE:7C>What?!<WAIT><FACE:7A>In my great name,<NL>I won't allow it!<WAIT>If the work runs late,<NL>my face is ruined!
<FACE:7D>(Worried about his own<NL>face again-robo…)<WAIT>(Without that he'd be<NL>a nice guy-robo…)
<FACE:79>Hmph! Fine, whatever<NL><WAIT>Fussing over details<NL>makes me look petty!
<FACE:81>Eeeeeeeeh!<NL><WAIT>Do that and the other<NL>tunnels lag-robo!<WAIT>We're already barely<NL>keeping up-robo!

<FACE:7A>Enough! Silence!<WAIT><FACE:79>You all know the plan:<NL>use this equipment<WAIT>to mass-produce<NL>Medabots by the ton,<WAIT>then hit those brats<NL>all at once!<WAIT><FACE:7A>I bragged to the other<NL>Bosses about supplies<WAIT>After that, I cannot<NL>afford to be late!
<FACE:7A>Absolutely no delays!<NL><WAIT>A delay in any Block<NL>is on all of you!<WAIT>If even one Block is<NL>late, you all get it!
<FACE:80>Aaaah! It's that kid<NL>again-robo!<WAIT><FACE:7E>So you're the ones<NL>in our way-robo!
<FACE:7A>Whaaat!<NL><WAIT>In that case, no mercy<NL>even for children!
<FACE:79>…That is to say…<NL><WAIT>Until now I held back<NL>since you're kids…
<FACE:7C>E-excuses?! How dare<NL>you say that!<WAIT>I, the great Raiun…!
<FACE:81>Boss Raiun lost-robo…<WAIT><FACE:06>What? Weren't you<NL>holding back so far?<WAIT><FACE:79>…I-I'm still too soft…<NL>If I'd used That…<WAIT><FACE:09>That?
<FACE:79>With That I'd have won<NL>but it ends horribly…
<FACE:79>For today I'll call it<NL>a loss<WAIT>Next time won't go the<NL>same! I'll use That…<WAIT><FACE:05>That what?
<FACE:7B>Heh heh… even I can't<NL>be cruel to children…<WAIT>Not using That at all!<NL>Bwaa ha ha ha!
<FACE:05>Anyway, Medabot<NL>development is safe<WAIT>Reset the controls and<NL>let's move on!

<FACE:2A>Stop the bomb timer,<NL>quick!<WAIT><FACE:2B>It's fine!<NL>They won't stay long<WAIT><FACE:2A>It's too dangerous!<WAIT><FACE:2B>But… this is the only<NL>way to save ourselves<WAIT>You said it yourself,<NL>Amamiya!<WAIT>That we misfits would<NL>pull through alone!
<FACE:03>No way!<WAIT><FACE:2B>That's right… we're<NL>wrecking this Block!<WAIT><FACE:04>But why would you do<NL>something like that…

<FACE:0F>This Block is the<NL>Cluster's center…<WAIT>Destroy it and the<NL>Cluster's cut in two!<WAIT><FACE:00>Shiden… then what<NL>happens?<WAIT><FACE:0F>Beyond here, thrusters<NL>keep it accelerating…<WAIT>The Lobby-side Blocks<NL>lose thrust, then…
<FACE:2B>The sun pulls us back<NL>close to Earth again!
<FACE:12>That's crazy! Nobody<NL>knows where we'd go!<WAIT><FACE:01>And someone's surely<NL>in the Blocks ahead!
<FACE:06>For starters, we were<NL>nearly caught in it!
<FACE:2B>It's now or never!<NL><WAIT>Any farther from Earth<NL>and this won't work!<WAIT><FACE:10>But at least think of<NL>everyone's safety…
<FACE:2B>And these two agreed…<NL><WAIT>We'll do it with our<NL>own strength!<NL><WAIT><FACE:2D>Even we can…<NL>save everybody…
<FACE:2B>So it's a Robattle?<NL><WAIT>Fine! We'll face you<NL>using Medabots here…
<FACE:29>All right, Tensai…<NL>I'll lend you a hand<WAIT><FACE:04>…Amamiya…
<FACE:29>This'll satisfy you…<WAIT><FACE:2D>If everyone… would<NL>listen to my voice…
<FACE:2D>But this was all I<NL>could think of…
<FACE:29><PLAYER>…<NL><WAIT>Retaken this much<NL>already… well done<WAIT>But all are desperate,<NL>some try risky things
<FACE:29>I won't tell you to<NL>accept it… just…<WAIT>Don't forget there are<NL>people like that<WAIT><FACE:04>…Got it<NL>I'll remember that…
<FACE:05>Those were our<NL>classmates, right?<WAIT>What were they calling<NL>off?
<FACE:14>Hm? What is it?<NL><WAIT>You haven't taken it<NL>back yet, right?
<FACE:0F>Take this back and we<NL>can make new Medabots
<FACE:29>Amamiya joined the<NL>team!<WAIT><FACE:2B>Tensai joined the<NL>team!<WAIT><FACE:2F>Nadare joined the<NL>team!
<FACE:03>Isn't this a Tinpet?!<NL><WAIT>Ah, a Medal too!<WAIT><FACE:04>Why are they here…<NL><WAIT>Whose could they be?
<FACE:00>Oh, Hiyori<NL><WAIT>There's a Tinpet lying<NL>here, so I wondered…
<FACE:0F>Hmm…<NL><WAIT>No RR control number<NL>on it… not ours…
<FACE:05>So there might be<NL>someone up ahead!<WAIT><FACE:07>Well, just keep it!
